title: SVG Government Gazette Vol 159, No. 9, 2026
text:
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Friday 30th January, – (No. 5) 77
SAINT VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES
( E X T R A O R D I N A R Y )
Published by Authority
[Vol. 159] Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Wednesday 18th February, 2026 – (No. 9)
G O V E R N M E N T N O T I C E
No. 17
LEGISLATIONS
____________
The following Document is published in today's issue of the Gazette and can be
purchased at the Government Printing Office, Campden Park Industrial Estate:-
S. R. & O. No. 2 of 2026:– Virtual Asset Business Regulations 2026.
____________
The following Acts which were assented to by His Excellency the Governor-General
are published in today's issue of the Gazette and can be purchased at the Government
Printing Office, Campden Park Industrial Estate:-
Act No. 1 of 2026:– Appropriation Act, 2026.
Act No. 2 of 2026:– Public Sector Investment Loan Act, 2026.
Act No. 3 of 2026:– Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court (St. Vincent and the Grenadines)
(Amendment) Act, 2026.
18th February, 2026.
____________
BY COMMAND
____________
KATTIAN BARNWELL-SCOTT
Secretary to Cabinet
Prime Minister’s Office
Prime Minister’s Office
St. Vincent and the Grenadines.
18th February, 2026.
Printed by the Government Printer at the Government Printing Office,
Campden Park Industrial Estate, St. Vincent and the Grenadines.
___________
2026 [Price $2.00]
